name: Short-Stay Visa (Type C) / Schengen Short Stay

requirements.blocker_text: Passport must be issued within the last 10 years and remain valid at least 3 months beyond the intended departure date.

requirements.fix_path: Purchase a qualifying Schengen travel insurance policy.

requirements.blocker_text: Proof of sufficient funds for the stay, plus proof of accommodation and a travel itinerary.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days in any 180-day period (Schengen short-stay, applies to Romania and the wider Schengen Area since Romania's full accession)

sources.title: AXA Schengen (travel-insurance provider) -- Romania short-stay Schengen visa (Type C): 90/180 day rule, application via evisa.mae.ro, embassy/consulate appointment, biometrics, apply 2 weeks to 3 months before departure

European Commission (Migration and Home Affairs) -- Bulgaria and Romania join the Schengen Area: land border controls lifted 1 January 2025, completing full Schengen membership after air/sea accession in March 2024
